arguments.explanation: Flags a random sample of about 1% of all transactions for manual review. Each transaction is selected independently, so the sample differs each time the rule runs.
assumptions: 'Random 1%' means each transaction has an independent 1-in-100 chance of being flagged, not a fixed sample of exactly 1%.
The rule covers all transactions, not only labelled ones, and is not conditioned on amount, card, or merchant.
The sample is not reproducible: each evaluation selects a different set of transactions.
